events.credibility_reason: Withdrawn by the author, who identified an error in Theorem 4.7 that 'ruins the double deformation construction'.

events.what: Colliot-Thélène and Schreieder prove ℓ-divisibility of Bloch–Ogus coniveau steps of motivic cohomology with Q_ℓ/Z_ℓ coefficients (Theorem 1.4, 'the weaker assertion'), and answer their own Question 1.7 in special cases (i,n) where the étale cycle class map is injective

judgement.doubts: The 2026 paper's results concern motivic cohomology with Q_ℓ/Z_ℓ coefficients and a coniveau-filtration divisibility statement the authors themselves call 'the weaker assertion'; the record never establishes that any of its special cases yields K_i(X)⊗Q = 0 for any new class of varieties (its own what_would_settle_it concedes this). Under the bullet's wording this is a changed question, not a case or bound. If a later reader shows Appendix C gives rational K-group vanishing for a new class of X, this would become partial. The 2023 surfaces paper is pre-snapshot partial work and does not make the row open_stale.

corrections.why: F3/other: the record says Theorem 1.4 proves 'the weaker assertion' about Q_ℓ/Z_ℓ-coefficient motivic cohomology, and its competing_reading and what_would_settle_it admit no link to rational vanishing of K-groups was shown. That is a variant of the bullet, which is discarded; the only other event (arXiv:2011.05544) was withdrawn in 2020. Nothing is left, and nothing resolved the problem before the snapshot, so the status is open.
F14: open carries a null direction; 'confirmed' was already inconsistent with the record's own 'progress' status.
other: no event after the snapshot survives step 1; the record's competing_reading gives exactly this outcome.
